messages:
aurora_pm: Hi team — Aurora Ledger wants to onboard a custom 6B summarizer tuned on invoices and ledger notes. Requirements: redact VAT/IBAN, zero raw transcript persistence, EU-hosted private deployment, HSM for signing. Go-live target ~3 weeks. Can we scope?

sam_cs: High level yes. Please share artifact link, tokenizer, and a small sanitized eval set. cc @kevin_eval and @nina_ops.

aurora_pm: Artifact: https://s3.auroralog.com/ledger-sum-6b-v3.tar.gz. Tokenizer included. Data: ~80k invoices, 18k notes. Uploading 350-sample sanitized eval tonight.

kevin_eval: Eval questions: 1) Deterministic summaries for audits? 2) Any explainability/export needs (highlights)? 3) Latency/throughput targets?

aurora_pm: Deterministic required for audit trails. No explainability exports initially. Latency target p95 <= 220ms for 512 tokens. Renewal tied to latency and zero-data-leak tolerance — high sensitivity.

nina_ops: Ops notes: EU Private + HSM supported. We'll need VPC peering + key provisioning. A100 suggested for p95 target with int8. We can enable a pre-log redaction hook and store only HSM-signed proofs for audits. Need model spec (input shapes) and tokenizer.

kevin_eval: Eval plan: I'll build a Redwood Optimize harness. Metrics: ROUGE/F1, hallucination rate, PII residuals (VAT/IBAN), determinism score, latency. Need 350 labeled eval examples + 150 adversarial PII probes. Proposed canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on any PII residual > 0 or p95 breach. ETA: 48h after samples arrive.

sam_cs: I'll open compliance ticket and schedule enablement. Legal will require a live redaction + HSM-signed response demo before sign-off.

aurora_pm: Will upload samples and acceptance criteria doc to shared bucket tonight. Legal also wants a data-flow diagram and retention policy.

legal-bot: Legal requires proof that no raw inputs leave EU and that signed proofs do not contain PII. Also request retention TTL for audit logs.

nina_ops: Noted. We'll set logs to ephemeral by default and persist only signed proofs in EU storage for 1 year per request (customer pays storage). HSM provisioning ~5 business days after compliance ok.

sam_cs: Ticket CS-9347 opened: "Aurora Ledger 6B private EU + HSM intake" — assignees: sam_cs, kevin_eval, nina_ops. Provisioning window estimate: 2026-05-01..2026-05-10.

aurora_pm: Thanks all. Can the demo show redaction + signed proof flow? Important for legal.

kevin_eval: Yes — demo will include: raw request -> redaction hook -> deterministic summary -> HSM-signed proof -> post-scan showing zero residual PII.

sam_cs: Scheduling enablement Thu 10am CET. I'll add renewal-risk watch to the account: HIGH until post-canary if we miss p95 or any PII residuals.

aurora_pm: Appreciate it — uploading now and standing by for the call.
